name: warnings2
title: Follow-up to `warnings` (owner 2026-10-24; crates/fnv-game/src/aggro.rs 'The timing' and 'Guard packages', docs/spec-notes/idles.md section 14.3, docs/owner-review.md 'Warnings timed from the original'). Four open guesses. (1) t_*: the 15 s from warning to attack as two warnings 5 s apart and an attack 10 s after the second: the cash-room guard 0x00127950 (aggro radius 128, stationary, detects reliably) with fAITrespassWarningTimer / iGuardWarnings changed by setgs, and at TimeScale 60; read the time from his first procedure-44 sample with the draw cycle to in_combat 1. (2) r_*: the attack without warning inside half the aggro radius: the player put at 0.3-0.7 of the radius from the cash-room guard (128), the young gecko VERGSGecko6REF (500) and the coyote VERGSCoyote6REF (1024); read the distance at first detection and whether a procedure-44 phase comes before combat. (3) c_*: every game loop, the lengths of IsWeaponOut 1 / 0 and GetAnimAction 0 / 1 in the draw-holster cycle (2 s gecko, 2.5 s guard at every 5). (4) g_*: Guard packages' own warnings, never seen: Gomorrah's room guards (vGOMRoomGuard, no aggro radius of their own) and the cash-room door, the player 15 units from the guarded door, or 60 from the guard. Plugin version 7 (installed): no events, extra fields or screenshots; warnings2_v9.campaign.json adds GetTrespassWarningLevel and IsIdlePlaying once v9 is installed. Run each session alone (--only): setgs and a fight change the game for the sessions after. God mode only (no tdetect).
